about: Lines that legitimately differ between the app's Griffin job (tests/fixtures/plan_parity/app/<case>.sbatch) and `coperceive model run --slurm` for the same inputs. tests/test_plan_parity.py fails on a one-sided line no entry matches. side: cli, app or both; match: a full-line regex for ONE line (a trailing '  # comment' is dropped first); cases: the cases the entry applies to (default: all). Every app-side and both-side entry must match a one-sided line in EVERY case it applies to, so the app cannot drop the line; a cli-side entry must still match somewhere. kind: intended, the only kind (docs/adr/0021-app-model-runs-follow-the-cli-slurm-job.md decides it). Not listed, so they must be identical: the module lines (python/<v> from the venv's pyvenv.cfg, then the manifest's), --gres=gpu:1, --constraint, --time (the CLI's estimate), --mail-type, --output/--error (~/logs/%x-%j), PYTHONPATH, --cpus-per-task, --mem, set -euo pipefail, module purge, the partition, and the run block (`set +e`, model run, `RC=$?`, `set -e`, `echo "model run exit $RC"`), which the test also checks in place on both sides with the work copy and the exit after it. The scratch setup is also compared step by step on both sides (tests/test_plan_parity.py _scratch_setup: set -euo pipefail first, the scratch folder on the profile's template, its mkdir, the EXIT trap, TMPDIR and the work folder, in that order, before module purge), so the one-sided scratch lines here excuse only the variable's name (SCRATCH, SCRATCH_DIR), the app's mode 0700 and each side's own folders. An entry that names a case's paths lists its cases; spaces_and_quotes and proxy_jump_modules have their own rows for those lines, with the same reasons.
